course.title: Unit 1 My school-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（Do we have these rooms?）

sentences.content: Do you have a library? Yes, we do.
sentences.english: Do you have a library ? Yes , we do
sentences.chinese: 你们有图书馆吗？是的，我们有。

sentences.content: It’s so big! How many students are there in your class?
sentences.english: It's so big ! How many students are there in your class ?
sentences.chinese: 好大啊！你们班有多少学生？

sentences.content: Is that the computer room? No, it isn’t. It’s the teachers’ office.
sentences.english: Is that the computer room ? No , it isn't . It's the teachers' office
sentences.chinese: 那是电脑房吗？不，不是。那是教师办公室。

sentences.content: Do you have a music room? Yes, we do. It’s on the first floor.
sentences.english: Do you have a music room ? Yes , we do . It's on the first floor
sentences.chinese: 你们有音乐教室吗？是的，我们有。它在一楼。

sentences.content: This is my school. It’s cool!
sentences.english: This is my school . It's cool !

sentences.content: The library is on the second floor.
sentences.english: The library is on the second floor

sentences.content: The art room is next to the gym.
sentences.english: The art room is next to the gym
sentences.chinese: 美术教室在体育馆旁边。

sentences.content: Where is the teachers’ office? It’s next to the library.
sentences.english: Where is the teachers' office ? It's next to the library
sentences.chinese: 教师办公室在哪里？它在图书馆旁边。

sentences.content: Where is Classroom 1? It’s under the teachers’ office.
sentences.english: Where is Classroom 1 ? It's under the teachers' office
sentences.chinese: 1号教室在哪里？它在教师办公室下面。
